prospective_timing.trigger: The published R0 defaults HMM(hazard=12,lambda=1) and TCN(h=32,d=2,k=3,dropout=0,lr=3e-4,updates=200,dilations=1,2) did not pass the prespecified promotion gate.
prospective_timing.interpretation: Finite design-space coverage after a failed default screen; not a post-hoc rescue, VALID opening, or scientific closure.

superseded_execution.timing: launched before the residual-floor correction and before the 20260903c freeze

superseded_execution_20260903b.execution: capacity control, HMM, TCN and paired-metric collection completed; the coordinator then failed before the decision stage
superseded_execution_20260903b.reason: the launched snapshot preceded the all-candidate three-seed capacity gate and exposed a Nextflow decision-channel wiring failure

hmm.design: three log-spaced parent hazards crossed with all four evidence scales; deterministic HMM evaluation is vectorized over the five paired arms
hmm.event_deposition: unchanged nearest-locus/anchor evidence field; event_radius_cM is not an HMM factor

tcn.design: six-row balanced space-filling screen; no Cartesian expansion

event_radius_amendment.role: training shard calendar and continuous triangular event splat only
event_radius_amendment.metric_alignment: all candidates are scored at the fixed 0.05, 0.1, 0.2 and 0.5 cM edge tolerances; promotion remains fixed at 0.2 cM
event_radius_amendment.not_allowed: changing the radius after candidate metrics are observed

execution.paired_arm_budget_audit: RE, RD, POOLED, SHAM and GEOMETRY share requested_updates, validation_every and early_stopping_patience; each arm records requested_updates, completed_updates and best_checkpoint_update

residual_operator.training_loss: mean[-log(p_true + epsilon)] with the identical epsilon=1e-12
properties: RD with no splats is exactly raw F0
supported arms can revive a state assigned zero probability by FLARE
a true state with F0=0 retains a finite training gradient
the output remains on the probability simplex
residual_operator.reason: remove the prior clamp-and-renormalize RD-vs-F0 artifact and the proposal/loss floor mismatch before any consumable 20260903c candidate sweep execution

default_replay.hmm: reproduce all five published default-arm R0 metrics before evaluating HMM sweep candidates
default_replay.tcn: reference-only rerun under RAW_F0_GATED_MIXTURE_V3_COHERENT_FLOOR using the first capacity-qualified candidate; old TCN metrics are not an equivalence gate because the residual operator changed prospectively

triage_gate.primary: RE must have strictly higher boundary F1 at 0.2 cM and non-worse log-loss than F0, RD, POOLED, SHAM and GEOMETRY
guardrails: Brier score must be non-worse than every comparator
macro ancestry-dose MAE must be non-worse than every comparator
NAM ancestry-dose MAE must be non-worse than every comparator
false transitions per Morgan must be non-worse than every comparator

positive_control_policy.capacity_rung_execution: each synthetic rung executes exactly its requested updates, scores the final state, disables early stopping and does not restore a best checkpoint
positive_control_policy.empirical_reason_for_exact_rungs: in the prelaunch diagnostic, the requested 1600-update spatial-XOR run stopped at update 300 and restored update 200, making the larger ladder rung ineffective
positive_control_policy.promotion_precondition: Each of the 12 HMM hazard/lambda pairs must pass its deterministic additive control. Each TCN candidate must pass additive, local feature-XOR, its one-bit ablation negative control and structural-zero revival in at least two of the fixed three seeds before it can touch real FIT/TUNE features.
positive_control_policy.effective_budget_rule: For each candidate/seed pair, stop at the first passing rung. For an eligible candidate, use the second-smallest first-pass rung, the minimum budget meeting the 2-of-3 seed rule, unchanged across all five real-data arms.
positive_control_policy.failure_rule: Failure at 200 updates alone means possible undertraining. Failure through 1600 means the candidate did not pass this capacity gate; neither result establishes absence of biological signal.

problems: the previous XOR score included a midpoint where triangular event mass and therefore the residual gate were exactly zero
the previous whole-shard loss was dominated by easy baseline markers outside the XOR target
the previous single-channel coding did not provide a clean mechanistic test of two-locus integration
invalidated_prelaunch_capacity_fixture.allowed_interpretation: The failed prelaunch diagnostic cannot be used to claim that TCN models lack capacity or that rare variants lack biological information.

capacity_control.fixture_geometry: 9 markers scaled to each candidate event radius; two XOR events are separated by four marker intervals, their positive triangular splats do not overlap, and loss plus scoring use one fixed positive-mass event anchor while excluding the zero-mass midpoint
capacity_control.capacity_only_loss_mask: An internal optional mask aligns the sealed synthetic loss and score at that directional anchor. Its default is null, and no production CLI, configuration or workflow can activate it.
capacity_control.baseline: uniform across the six diploid ancestry states for additive and XOR controls; for zero revival the target state NN starts at exact probability zero while the other five states share the mass
capacity_control.pattern_balance: FIT and held-out VALID contain balanced 00, 01, 10 and 11 two-locus patterns with disjoint synthetic person identifiers

tasks.additive: one centred log-likelihood contrast in the real evidence-channel slice determines a held-out diploid state
tasks.xor: two bits are placed in separate ancestry-evidence channels at two neighbouring loci with non-overlapping positive splats; their interaction determines a strict XOR label at the left anchor and either bit alone is uninformative
tasks.zero_revival: the true NN state has F0 probability exactly zero and must gain held-out probability through trained residual parameters
tasks.candidate_parameter_coverage: the fixture uses the same 23-channel schema as real materialization; channels 4:10 carry the synthetic evidence so each candidate's frozen evidence_scale is exercised together with architecture, optimizer and event radius

mechanistic_checks.positive_tcn: a TCN evaluated at the fixed directional anchor must exceed balanced accuracy 0.75 in at least two of the three fixed seeds
mechanistic_checks.one_bit_ablation_negative: the same TCN with one XOR bit removed must remain within 0.10 of chance balanced accuracy 0.50 in at least two of the three fixed seeds
mechanistic_checks.two_bit_oracle: a small multilayer perceptron receiving both bits directly must recover the XOR truth; this verifies that the fixture labels themselves are learnable
mechanistic_checks.scope: These checks establish only minimal directional two-locus synthetic capacity and absence of an obvious leakage path; they do not establish bidirectional capacity, biological signal or a particular cM reach in real data.

capacity_control.screen_seed_reuse_interpretation: Seed 1103 is the first fixed replicate and one of the three transparently reported replicates for every candidate; no candidate is ranked by it.
capacity_control.rung_training_policy_reason: a prelaunch diagnostic requested 1600 spatial-XOR updates but early stopping completed 300 and restored checkpoint 200; exact rungs are required for the ladder to measure additional optimization budget
capacity_control.capacity_score: minimum relative held-out log-loss gain across the three tasks
capacity_control.aggregation: report all seeds plus mean and median for all six candidates; ranking candidates or choosing only the best seed is forbidden
capacity_control.candidate_gate: all three positive tasks and the one-bit XOR ablation negative control pass in at least two of three seeds
capacity_control.effective_budget_rule: second-smallest first-pass rung, applied unchanged to RE, RD, POOLED, SHAM and GEOMETRY
capacity_control.real_data_gate: if no candidate passes, no TCN process receives real FIT/TUNE features
